meta.revisionPolicy: These published administrative counts and survey estimates may be revised by the agency; changed responses are archived before rebaking.
meta.coverage: Number of teachers by management, gender and classes taught: all published cross-tabs; class taught, gender, state, type of management
meta.note: Complete observed row grain from data/raw/profiles-mospi/udise-0-24.json. No Cartesian expansion or averaging of state ratios. Existing school structure. Earlier institution-level collection and student-level collection are separate bundles. Pre-primary excludes standalone Anganwadis; source zero GER cells without a usable estimate are null; other reported zeros remain source values. Source ratios may exceed 100 where counts and population bases differ.
